parameterRanges.evidencePolicy: path to a policy JSON; may only tighten the release policy

invariants: one entry per operation with operation, schemaHash, implementationHash (absent for schema-only), backendHash, availability, evidenceLevel, evidenceStatus, dimensions, scope, acceptancePackHash, evaluationPolicyHash, evaluators, runnable, productionEligible, blockers and artifactRefs
with an empty evidence registry every entry is schema-only / pending / not production-eligible with non-empty blockers
a caller policy can narrow scope or raise the required level but cannot weaken the release policy
a pack-hash or request-schema-hash mismatch against an admitted entry marks it stale and removes production eligibility
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass

fixtures.path: synthetic:v1 registry with the in-tree evidence registry (no admitted entries)
fixtures.note: testCapabilitiesAreSchemaOnlyPendingExceptDiscoveryHandlers: 35 entries, schema-only/pending, runnable iff implemented, blockers non-empty, signerAvailable false

fixtures.path: synthetic:evidencePolicy files with minimumLevel hand-wavy and a nonexistent path
synthetic:evidencePolicy that tries to clear requireCurrent
fixtures.note: testEvidencePolicyCanOnlyTighten: weakening ignored with warning EVIDENCE_POLICY_NOT_WEAKENED

mutants.description: testEvidencePolicyCanOnlyTighten: a policy that weakens requireCurrent must be ignored with a warning; a bad enum must be invalidRequest; a missing file must be missingCapability.

testEvidenceEntriesDriveStatusAndStaleness: an admitted entry whose packHash or requestSchemaHash no longer matches must report stale and lose production eligibility; a failed entry must carry an evidence-failed blocker.
testEvidenceRegistryLocatorAndDefaults: with no acceptance directory the locator returns nil and an empty registry yields schema-only/pending with a no-pack blocker, never a pass.

A report envelope claiming every DiscoveryPackTests test passed (executed 8, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Core/DiscoveryPackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: capabilities is a registry read that joins operation schemas with the evidence registry and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
